title: 2024 Kolkata R. G. Kar rape and murder
narrative: Post-mortem and FIR — R. G. Kar Medical College and Hospital, Kolkata, West Bengal, 9 August 2024. The deceased, a 31-year-old female postgraduate trainee doctor, was raped and killed by manual strangulation; the autopsy recorded a fracture of the thyroid cartilage. The accused, Sanjay Roy, a civic volunteer with the Kolkata Police, was arrested on 10 August 2024. The investigation was transferred to the Central Bureau of Investigation on 13 August 2024. Sanjay Roy was convicted under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and sentenced to life imprisonment.

locations: R. G. Kar Medical College and Hospital, Kolkata
